purpose: Retrieval-friendly, paraphrased OEM diagnostic knowledge for TruckFixHub Panta. Use as guidance and preserve application limits.

documents.title: Cummins J1939 data-link diagnosis with INSITE diagnostic tool
documents.source: Cummins QuickServe Online — J1939 Data Link Diagnostic Tool
documents.summary: For supported Cummins applications, INSITE includes a J1939 Data Link Diagnostic Tool intended to isolate OEM-side harness and aftertreatment-interface communication faults. Cummins directs technicians to begin the tool procedure with key OFF, connect INLINE 7 at the engine-side 3-pin service connector, choose a log-file location, then connect through the J1939 diagnostic tool. Opening the tool disconnects other ECM connections to reduce bus loading that can mask intermittent communication problems. Use the engine-specific service procedure and wiring diagram for pinouts and final isolation; do not condemn an ECM solely because normal scan communication is intermittent.

documents.title: Cummins aftertreatment and ECM replacement requires root-cause diagnosis
documents.authority: Cummins OEM warranty and service guidance
documents.source: Cummins QuickServe customer notice — aftermarket parts warranty diagnosis requirements
documents.summary: Cummins states that complaints leading to replacement of on-highway DOC, SCR, DPF or ECM components, and covered VG turbo actuators, must be diagnosed on-engine using published Cummins troubleshooting and service procedures for warranty qualification. Panta diagnostic rule: an aftertreatment fault code is not by itself proof that the DPF, DOC, SCR, ECM or turbo actuator is failed. Follow the applicable fault/symptom tree, verify inputs and root cause, and use the correct Cummins tools before recommending an expensive component.

documents.title: Eaton Fault Code 11 FMI 12 — TECU diagnostic rule
documents.authority: Eaton OEM warranty repair guideline RWRG0071
documents.source: Eaton — Transmission Electronic Control Unit Fault Code 11 FMI 12
documents.summary: Eaton's RWRG0071 applies a specific rule to active Fault Code 11 FMI 12: record codes, FMIs, occurrences and timestamps in the Service Activity Report. If Fault Code 11 FMI 12 is the only active code present under the guideline's applicable conditions, Eaton directs TECU replacement, followed by reconnecting components, key-on verification, clearing codes with ServiceRanger, road testing to reproduce the complaint, and rechecking faults. If other active faults exist, use the correct troubleshooting procedure for those faults rather than applying this shortcut blindly.

documents.title: Eaton UltraShift PLUS intermittent faults — Product Diagnostic Mode wiring checks
documents.authority: Eaton Cummins Automated Transmission Technologies OEM troubleshooting guide TRTS0940
documents.summary: On applicable UltraShift PLUS procedures, Eaton uses Product Diagnostic (PD) Mode to help expose intermittent wiring failures. The guide instructs technicians to record fault-code details first; PD Mode will not enter while active faults are present. Applicable isolation steps include inspecting and manipulating ECA power wiring, transmission harness connections and shift-control wiring for chafing, pinching, contamination or loose connections while watching for a fault to become active. Eaton also specifies allowing roughly 2–3 minutes for complete TECU power-down when exiting PD Mode. Follow the exact fault-code procedure and transmission generation before replacing a harness or component.

documents.title: Eaton automated transmission diagnosis — use ServiceRanger data and service routines
documents.summary: Eaton describes ServiceRanger as its diagnostic platform for supported Eaton and Eaton Cummins automated transmissions. Depending on license and product, it can retrieve faults, monitor live vehicle data, run service routines, create service activity reports, update software/calibrations and perform clutch-related calibration routines. Panta diagnostic rule: for an Eaton AMT complaint, capture current and inactive faults plus service activity information before clearing codes or replacing parts, and use the transmission-specific ServiceRanger procedure where available.

documents.title: Bendix ABS troubleshooting — begin with system diagnostics and service data
documents.source: Bendix Tech Tips — Antilock Braking System troubleshooting and repair, March 2023
documents.summary: Bendix directs technicians to its model-specific Service Data Sheets and Technical Bulletins for complete ABS maintenance and troubleshooting. Panta diagnostic rule: treat an ABS lamp or fault as the beginning of diagnosis, not automatic proof of a failed ECU or sensor. Identify the Bendix system and active diagnostic information, inspect the relevant wheel-end/electrical condition, and follow the applicable Bendix service-data procedure before component replacement. Safety-critical brake work should be verified using current OEM procedures by qualified personnel.
